description: This file defines the 'List' feature for comments, including a request model and a handler that fetches comments associated with an article identified by its slug.

classes.name: List
classes.description: Contains the request model 'Query' and the request handler for listing comments associated with an article.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Handles the query to retrieve comments for a specific article slug, returning a CommentsEnvelope or throwing a NotFound exception.
